description: Lab records with total cholesterol equal to 180 count as passing the filter (T-CHO at least 180).

a.request: For lab records that match a patient by ID (unmatched records dropped) and have total cholesterol (`T-CHO`) of 180 or higher, break them down by patient sex (`SEX`), keeping each recorded value, including a blank one, as its own group. For each group, show the sex, the average anti-DNA level (`Laboratory.DNA`), and the average of albumin minus total protein (`ALB` − `TP`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average empty if there are none, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.DNA) AS avg_DNA, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_ALB_minus_TP FROM Laboratory L INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY P.SEX

c.request: For lab records that match a patient by ID (unmatched records dropped), screened with 180 as the total cholesterol (`T-CHO`) cutoff, break them down by patient sex (`SEX`), keeping each recorded value, including a blank one, as its own group. For each group, show the sex, the average anti-DNA level (`Laboratory.DNA`), and the average of albumin minus total protein (`ALB` − `TP`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average empty if there are none, unrounded. Lab records with total cholesterol equal to 180 count as passing the filter (T-CHO at least 180).
c.sql: SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.DNA) AS avg_DNA, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_ALB_minus_TP FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY P.SEX

b.request: Among lab records that match a patient by ID (unmatched records dropped) and have total cholesterol (`T-CHO`) of at least 180 (a value of exactly 180 passes), group by patient `SEX`, with a blank or empty `SEX` kept as its own group, and for each group show `SEX`, the unrounded average of `Laboratory.DNA`, and the unrounded average of `ALB` − `TP`. Missing values are ignored, and the average is empty (NULL) if a group has none.
b.sql: SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(CASE WHEN TRIM(L.DNA) = '' THEN NULL ELSE L.DNA END) AS avg_DNA, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_ALB_minus_TP FROM Laboratory L INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY P.SEX
b.raw: Among lab records that match a patient by ID (unmatched records dropped) and have total cholesterol (`T-CHO`) of at least 180 (a value of exactly 180 passes), group by patient `SEX`, with a blank or empty `SEX` kept as its own group, and for each group show `SEX`, the unrounded average of `Laboratory.DNA`, and the unrounded average of `ALB` − `TP`. Missing values are ignored, and the average is empty (NULL) if a group has none.

d.request: For lab records joined to patients by ID (inner join, unmatched dropped) with `T-CHO` >= 180 (a value of exactly 180 passes), group by patient `SEX` (with NULL or blank values each kept as their own group) and return `SEX`, the unrounded average of `Laboratory.DNA`, and the unrounded average of (`ALB` − `TP`), ignoring NULLs and returning NULL where a group has no values.
d.sql: SELECT P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.DNA) AS avg_DNA, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_ALB_minus_TP FROM Laboratory L INNER JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY P.SEX
